title: Queue entry
description: One queue entry: who requests, who is assigned and what it is about are fields, not separate queues or records. foundry-build-0048 U5 writes kind slot (SLOT-CREATE); U7 adds the work kinds change and fix and the route the router writes (queue/routing.ts): a requester slot, or the owner, names a slot no agent holds; the assignee agent reuses a placed slot or creates one. Written by `clossys request` (and by `clossys ia`, `clossys feedback` and the SCOPE scan) at clossys/agents/producer/queue.slot/entries/<id>.json; `clossys request <id> --close` links the requester slot-to-slot, notifies it and closes the entry. The clossys.queue-entry/1 writers (queue.pick, queue.approve, queue.clarify, queue.fix) are unchanged; a later unit moves them to this shape. `events` is the entry's own ledger: each event has an id `<entry id>#<n>`, and `opened`/`closed` name the raising and closing events. The validator has no conditionals: kind slot needs a slot-ref target and rel, a reuse decision needs reuse and overlaps, a create decision proposal and overlaps, and a closed entry decision, link, notified, closed and closedAt (records/request.ts requestIssues).

kind.description: What is asked. pick, approve, clarify and fix are the clossys.queue-entry/1 queues; slot: a slot that does not exist yet; change: a change to a placed slot; report: the tool itself is wrong or missing a step (a bug, gap or ask about a verb, skill or agent), owned by Producer (records/report.ts).

from.description: The requester: an agent slot ref, or the owner for a need with no requester slot.

assignee.description: Who executes the entry: an agent id, or the owner.

target.description: What the entry is about: a slot ref <agent>/<slot id> (kind slot: the slot the requester names, which no slot holds when raised; kind change or fix: the placed slot) or an L2 home <agent>/<l1>/<l2>.

opened.description: The id of the raised ledger event (an id in events).

closed.description: The id of the closed ledger event (an id in events).

link.description: The closing slot ref: the slot the requester now cites (the created or reused one).

rel.description: kind slot: how the requester cites the slot once it exists.

createdBy.description: Who raised the entry, as clossys.queue-entry/1 createdBy: the owner (with where the words were said), the planner, or the code verb that filed it.

refs.description: As clossys.queue-entry/1 refs: the requester slot (rel raisedBy) when a slot raised the entry.

overlaps.description: kind slot: the overlap check over the assignee's placed slots (`clossys request <id> --check`): every slot the need may duplicate.

overlapReason.description: kind slot, decision create over a listed overlap: why the proposal is a new leaf, not the overlapping slot. The owner signs it with the leaf.

reuse.description: decision reuse: the placed slot the requester cites instead.

proposal.description: kind slot, decision create: the new leaf the assignee proposes; the owner signs it before `ia` places it.

inputs.description: The new leaf's inputs (slot refs): the placement overlap check compares them with the assignee's placed slots in the same L2.

notified.description: The ledger event addressed to the requester when the entry closed.

option.description: An answered event: the id of the option the owner chose (one of the entry's options). Its detail is the owner's optional note, which changes nothing.

inputsSha256.description: A verified event's digest of the inputs the requester check judged (foundry-build-0048 U7 r3, records/request.ts inputsSha256): sha256 over the sorted paths of slot.json and pin.json of each judged slot, each path NUL bytes. Conform Q7 re-runs the checks while it is unchanged.

route.description: Written by the router only (queue/routing.ts routeEntry, foundry-build-0048 U7): the routing.json row that matched, the table's sha256, the assignee and either the agent's declared handler or the owner's MC packet. Re-deriving it from the table gives the same route. A kind report is routed by Producer's one upstream rule (records/report.ts REPORT_RULE), never a routing.json row: row upstream, the rule's sha256, assignee producer.

delegated.description: Routed after the owner's handoff answer: the router skipped the owner-class row (queue/routing.ts routeEntry delegated), so the entry now goes to the target agent's handler.

options.description: The owner's closed choices (foundry-build-0048 U7 r4): every entry assigned to the owner carries them from its raise, and an agent's fix claim the owner must judge carries them from its asked event. Each option is an id, a label and `then`, the predetermined next step as data: a Producer verb and its args. `pin <agent>/<slot> <candidate>` pins through the pin gate and closes changed; `close <outcome>` closes through the closure rule; `handoff <agent>` re-routes the entry to that agent's declared handler; `reject` sends an agent's claim back to it, open. An owner answer records only the chosen option id (records/request.ts answerRequest); Producer then runs `then`, and the entry closes only when that step's own check passes.

about.description: kind report: what the report is about, <verb|skill|agent>/<name> (a clossys verb, an installed skill or an agent).

what.description: kind report: a bug (it is wrong), a gap (a step has no verb) or an ask (it should do more).

evidence.description: kind report: what shows it. A repo file (path and its sha256 when filed), or a check command (`clossys check ...`) with the exit code and output it gave when filed; a fixed close re-runs the check.

signature.description: CP1-LOOP-LEARN: the failure text normalized (paths, shas, times and numbers removed). A signed report dedupes on about, what and signature, and one matching a fixed-closed report is a repeat.

want.description: kind change: what the requester wants of the placed slot.

check.description: kind fix: the check that failed on the slot.

findings.description: kind fix: the check's findings, verbatim.

cause.description: kind fix: what broke the slot (the repin, run or record that changed).

outcome.description: A closed entry: what came of it.

result.description: A closed entry: the ref that resolves to the result (a slot, pin, candidate or answered queue entry).

guard.description: kind report, CP1-LOOP-LEARN: a fixed close's guard, the scripts/rules/registry.json rule (with a fixture run) that keeps the cause fixed.

repeatOf.description: kind report, CP1-LOOP-LEARN: the fixed-closed report this one repeats (same about, what and signature), and the guard that close named.
